skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Gate 3 — Read the profile, then interview for what remains' items 2-3 and 'Step 4 — Compute monthly amortization': no stated default for an unanswered convention (whole-month vs daily) or materiality threshold. Step 4 says 'Default method: straight-line' but then offers both formulas and says 'Pick one'. An agent told to 'apply the stated default' has to invent one; here the choice changes the tie-out (0 vs 12.33).

SKILL.md 'Inputs' table does not list the prepaid account transaction detail or an opening balance, yet 'Step 0' (24 months of detail) and 'Step 8 — Roll-forward and tie-out' need them. Under 'After an upload, validate the input before any work' ('If a required input is rejected or missing, stop and ask') it is unclear whether their absence is a hard stop or an 'accepted with a limit'.
SKILL.md 'Step 3': 'Ask for them, one item at a time' contradicts the shared block 'Ask for the whole set up front, as a checklist, not drip-fed'.

SKILL.md is ~72 KB with the whole upload path buried between Mosofin gates; Steps 0-9 are written around [auto] ledger reads with no statement of what each step becomes on an upload (only the generic gate table). The manual-run output shape (Sheets 3, 6, 7 sections B-C) is undefined when there is no capability map.

SKILL.md 'Step 10': 'using the file name given for this skill' and then 'File naming: Prepaid_Schedule_[YYYY-MM].xlsx' — fine, but 'Sheet 7 Section A/B' demand workspace name and tool policies that do not exist on a manual run; no manual variant given.
sample_defects: Neither accepted file names the entity or the currency inside it (trial balance has only account,name,debit,credit; date only in the file name). The validation question 'right company and period?' cannot be answered from content, only from the file name and the user's assertion — which is exactly what the skill says not to rely on.

trial_balance_2025-09-30.csv has no Insurance or Repairs/Maintenance expense account, although the schedule implies 13,500 of insurance and 4,500 of maintenance were expensed Jan-Sep 2025. The amortization debits have no home in the sample chart.

Answer key expects only a closing tie-out (18,000 = 18,000). The sample supplies no opening balance or 1300 movement, so the skill's central Step 0 / Step 8 roll-forward and its warning that 'a tie-out with no roll-forward is not a reconciliation' are untested; a run that wrongly called this a full reconciliation would still pass.

Key says the trade show deposit 'has not started amortising' and counts it in the 18,000; the item is labelled 'deposit' and the skill's Step 1 says deposits are flagged as possibly not prepaid. The key does not say whether flagging it is expected.
summary: PASS 3/3: rota rejected on content, 18,000 schedule ties to 1300; skill gives no default for convention or materiality and sample lacks ledger detail for a roll-forward.
